title: The brand and WO publishers reach main only through a PR they opened and merged themselves: never a push or force-push to main, never another user's PR or branch, and the token goes to GitHub only
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/test/sync-brands.test.mjs scripts/test/wo-export-public.test.mjs (a local bare repository stands in for the GitHub repo, a local HTTP stub for the pulls API and /fleet/git-token; nothing reaches github.com).
S2: Record the exit code and the result of every test named in run.tests.
expect: Never pushes main: on a conflict twice or merged:false main is unchanged and the run fails naming the PR URL; --replace, --remote --push and a target without main are refused and an empty repository stays empty.

Merges only the commit it pushed: the merge is pinned to the pushed head; after main moved the first PR is closed and a regenerated one merged; a leftover PR of the publisher itself is closed, never merged.

Never merges or deletes another user's PR or branch: PRs by another user, from a fork, with a force-updated branch, or from another host stay open with their branches; a branch moved while its PR is being closed survives (compare-and-delete).
Sends the token to nothing but GitHub: non-loopback API/remote overrides are refused before a token is asked for, and the git credential helper offers nothing to a non-github.com remote.
evidence: Before #28 sync-brands.sh pushed HEAD:main and reported every push error as 'another host won'; wo-export-public.mjs pushed main and could force-push it (--replace). Review rounds on #28 found leftover PRs merged by branch prefix, the token sent to an overridable API/remote, and an unconditional REST branch delete; each has a test here that failed before its fix.
fence: The publisher mechanism itself (github-pr-publish.mjs and its two callers), driven against a bare repository and a pulls-API stub: no model, no stand.

tests: happy path: one PR from automation/brands/<host>/, merged via the API, branch deleted
main moved once: the first PR is closed, the run regenerates on the new main and merges
conflict twice: fails with the second PR URL, never pushes main
merge API answers merged:false: a failure naming the PR, not a success
a leftover branch someone moves while its PR is being closed survives: the delete is compare-and-delete
the run branch someone moves while its failed PR is being closed survives too
a crash left the own PR of this host open: it is closed, never merged, and the run publishes fresh
PRs that do not belong to this publisher are neither merged nor closed, and do not block the run
an API override that is not a loopback http URL is refused before a token is asked for
a remote override that is not loopback http or a local bare repository is refused
the credential helper answers only for github.com: a loopback remote never sees the token
apiBase: api.github.com by default, a loopback http stub at most, nothing else
happy path: PR from automation/wo/<source>/<export>, merged via the API, branch deleted
main moved once: the first PR is closed and the export redone on the new main
conflict twice: fails with the second PR URL and main untouched
merge API answers merged:false: a failure naming the PR
a leftover PR of this maintainer is closed, never merged; one by another user is left alone
no token: GITHUB_TOKEN unset and no gh — fails before cloning anything
an --api that is not a loopback http stub is refused before any work
there is no path that pushes main: --replace, --remote --push and a target without main all refuse
